now.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
now.text: In episode 9, with Iron Man's help and a tip from Norman, Secretary Ross arrests him for breaking the Sokovia Accords and seizes his tech. When Norman gloats over his deal with Ross for Otto's inventions, Otto vows to get him.

proposed.text: In episode 9, with Iron Man's help and a tip from Norman, Secretary Ross arrests him for breaking the Sokovia Accords and seizes his tech. When Norman gloats over his deal with Ross for Otto's inventions, Otto accuses him of exploiting the work of others and insists he will always be worth more than Norman.

changes.evidence: In 'Hero or Menace' (episode 9), Norman visits Otto in jail to gloat that he tipped off Ross and that Oscorp is seizing Otto's inventions; Otto lashes out, calling Norman out for exploiting the work of others, and claims he will always be worth more than Norman. The episode's detailed plot shows no vow of revenge, so 'Otto vows to get him' is a detail the screen does not show.
